Why send a parcel with Evri?

With Evri, you can quickly send a parcel cheaply across the whole of the UK and beyond. UK prices start at £2.62! Even when choosing our standard delivery service, you’ll get immediate access to the following parcel service benefits:

Complete delivery flexibility

Post a package using any one of our 10,000+ ParcelShops and Lockers across the UK or book a delivery straight from your door with our Courier Collection service, matter where you are in the country.

A quality delivery service

With our standard parcel service, you get full tracking on every delivery, photo confirmation of your parcel’s arrival, and free cover up to a value of £20 as standard. We’ll even provide you with a 1-hour window for both collection and delivery, with our Couriers making up to 3 delivery attempts before diverting your parcel to your nearest ParcelShop.

A cheaper parcel service

We’ll always aim to give you the best prices when you post a parcel with Evri, regardless of whether you choose to use our ParcelShops, Lockers, or Courier Collection service.

Our 3 easy ways to send a parcel

We’ve made it easy to post a parcel with Evri by offering you three simple ways to post packages. Learn more about how to use our ParcelShops, Lockers, and Courier Collection service below:

Our ParcelShops

We have 9,000+ ParcelShops dotted around the UK for you to use. Simply use our ParcelShop finder tool to locate your closest shop, print your label at home or in-store, for free, and hand your parcel over to the cashier – we’ll take care of the rest!

ParcelShops

Our Lockers

Like our ParcelShops, our Evri parcel Lockers are a quick, secure, and easy way to drop off your parcels. Open 24/7, you can post a parcel at a time and place convenient to you. Just book a spot online, leave your parcel in one of the available Lockers, and our Couriers will collect it for delivery.

Lockers

Our Courier Collection

Unable to drop your parcel off in person? Not to worry, our Evri Couriers can come straight to you! Whether you’re at home, in the office, or with family, you can book a parcel pick up straight from your door. We’ll even give you a 1 hour window so you can be in to greet your Courier.

Courier Collection

Choose your parcel delivery option

When sending a parcel with Evri, you can choose from either of our two cheap parcel services – standard delivery or Next Day delivery:

Standard delivery from £2.62

Our equivalent of sending a parcel second class with Royal Mail, you can use any of our ParcelShops, Lockers, or Courier Collection services to get your parcel delivered in 2 to 3 days.

Next Day delivery from £3.20

Drop your parcel off at your nearest ParcelShop or Locker by 12pm on a weekday and we’ll do our best to deliver it for the following working day when you choose our Next Day delivery service.

Send parcels abroad

Did you know you can post a parcel overseas with Evri? We deliver to over 200+ countries and territories for just £6.08! Whether you’re sending gifts to friends and loved ones or items to customers, we can help you post a package fast.

Find out more about sending packages internationally to see how much you could save on sending your parcel abroad.

Send a parcel FAQs

Can I buy cover for my parcel?

We include parcel cover up to a value of £20, for free, on most items sent with us – excluding prohibited items and postable parcels. However, if your parcel’s value is worth more than £20, then you can increase the value of your item’s cover up to a maximum of £999.

It’s important to note, however, that some items you can send with us can’t be covered. These are called non-compensation items and include items such as glassware, furniture, musical instruments, TVs, legal documents, and items valued over £999.

Please take a look at our non-compensation items list for a breakdown of what items we can and can’t cover. We’re still happy to carry non-compensation items for delivery but know that when you send any of these items with us, you do so at your own risk.

Naturally, on top of those items that fall under our non-compensation category, any item that is flagged as a prohibited item is not covered by our parcel service, no matter its value.

Can I change the delivery address after I’ve sent a parcel?

Yes. If it’s a simple house name/number change, the easiest thing to do is ask the parcel recipient to divert the parcel to the correct house name/number.

If, on the other hand, your recipient needs a full address change, then contact our customer service team with the change you need once the parcel is with its Courier. We’ll then do our best to get the parcel stopped and the address corrected before the delivery is made to the original address.

How will I know when my parcel has been delivered?

You can track your parcel through its entire journey, right up until the point of delivery with our parcel tracking service . This means you can see where your parcel is at each stage of the delivery process. We explain each stage of the process on our tracking page to make this easy to follow.

Cookie settings

By selecting "Accept all", you agree to the storing of cookies on your device to enhance site navigation, analyse site usage, and help us improve your experience.

Cookie settings

When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalised web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to find out more and change our default settings. However, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.
Cookie policy

Manage your preferences

Strictly Necessary Cookies

Always active

These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

Functional Cookies

These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

Targeting Cookies

These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.

Performance Cookies

These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.
